english.meaning: so (then) just ... instead; used to say someone simply didn't bother because of what came before
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: That time at school was so hard, so I didn’t bother.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我嗰次喺學校洗好辛苦所以咪搞。
